name: d4-booking
description: Appointment booking: bookable services with durations and prices, weekly availability windows, generated time slots in the business's own timezone, and a public booking flow. Slots already taken disappear, a booking is re-checked against the live diary before it is accepted, and confirmations are emailed to both sides via Resend when configured. Bookings are managed from the dashboard.
clientFacingSummary: Customers book appointments on your site: you set your services and your working hours, and they pick from the times you are actually free.

env.name: RESEND_API_KEY
env.description: Shared with the site template contact form. When set with CONTACT_TO_EMAIL, new bookings are emailed to the owner and confirmed to the customer.
